Anna (CS): Heads up — MosaicMed prepping AP-SOUTH demo tomorrow. They hit staging throttles during load test. Need temp QPS increase + CIDR allowlist. Renewal ~6 weeks out; this demo is high-stakes for renewal. Request: org qps 120 -> 800, CIDRs 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/26, start 2026-03-24T03:00Z, duration 48h, autorevoke at 72h. Can infra/security review? :pray:

Jordan (SE): Copy. Org id? Traffic shape?

Anna (CS): org_mosaicmed_42. Chat completions, avg 256 tokens. Baseline ~120 RPS, demo bursts up to ~800 RPS for 20-40m. Origin region ap-south-1, limited egress IPs.

Mike (NetOps): I can add CIDRs and temporary rate policy. Need ticket with exact times + justification. Also confirm region routing — ap-south only or allow failover?

Anna (CS): AP-SOUTH only for pilot. Start 2026-03-24T03:00Z, end 2026-03-26T03:00Z, autorevoke 2026-03-27T03:00Z. CIDRs repeated above. I'll open the ticket and note renewal risk.

Sophie (Security): Quick Q — MosaicMed on hosted API (not private)? If hosted, prefer header-based allowlist + HMAC signing instead of broad CIDR opens. Do they guarantee static egress IPs? We should avoid wide edge openings.

Anna (CS): They confirmed static egress CIDRs and can add an HMAC-signed X-Company-Signature header if we require it. They prefer hosted for speed.

Jordan (SE): Proposed plan: create a canary route for org_mosaicmed_42 with soft cap at 800 qps, monitor for 30m, then promote. Drop smoke test snippet here.

Jordan (SE): ```bash
# smoke test to canary route
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Company-Signature: sha256=..." \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org_mosaicmed_42" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"healthcheck"}'
```

Mike (NetOps): Opening ticket now. Will include CIDRs, times, and monitoring/alert requirements.

Mike (NetOps): INC-5428 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5428 — MosaicMed AP-SOUTH pilot temp QPS bump + CIDR allowlist. ETA for config apply: ~20m.

Sophie (Security): Please make HMAC header optional but strongly recommended. Add an alert: 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 1.0s -> page on-call. Also note escalation path if we see anomalous source IPs.

Anna (CS): Added renewal-risk flag in ticket and pinged account manager for follow-up meeting. Requested HMAC token from customer before pilot. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rate limit policy queued: org=org_mosaicmed_42 qps=800 duration=48h autorevoke=72h allowlist=[203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/26] region=ap-south-1

Mike (NetOps): Rules applied to ap-south edge. INC-5428 updated with changelog. Monitor canary and confirm.

Jordan (SE): Canary healthy after 25m — no 5xx, p95 ~0.45s. Promoted to soft-prod route, keeping 800 qps cap.

Anna (CS): Great — demo scheduled tomorrow. I'll monitor and run the renewal healthcheck meeting on 2026-04-05. Thanks all! :party:
